claims.sentence: This report aims to provide an overview of recent COMISA research.</jats:p> </jats:sec><jats:sec> <jats:title>Recent Findings</jats:title> <jats:p>This report presents an overview of emerging areas of COMISA research over the past 5 years, including (1) mental and physical health associations of COMISA, (2) bi-directional relationships between insomnia and sleep apnoea, (3) positive airway pressure therapy for COMISA and (4) cognitive behavioural therapy for COMISA.
